name: Duty of Care
description: Legal obligation to avoid acts/omissions causing foreseeable harm to others.

name: Negligence
description: Failure to exercise reasonable care, resulting in damage to another party.

name: Breach of Contract
description: Failure to perform any duty or obligation specified in a binding contract.

name: Freedom of Speech
description: Constitutional protection against government restriction of expression.

name: Due Process
description: Requirement that legal proceedings follow established rules and principles.

name: Vicarious Liability
description: Holding one party liable for the wrongful acts of another (e.g. employer/employee).

name: Proximate Cause
description: The legal cause of an injury which, in natural sequence, produced the harm.

name: Doctrine of Precedent
description: Principle (stare decisis) that courts follow rulings established in prior similar cases.

name: Intellectual Property Rights
description: Legal rights granted for creations of the mind (patents, copyrights, trademarks).

name: Right to Privacy
description: Legal protection of an individual's personal information and autonomy.
